caption: Kevin Durant scored 20 points and became the fifth player in NBA history to reach 33,000 career points, joining LeBron James, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Karl Malone and Kobe Bryant as the Houston Rockets beat the Phoenix Suns 116-104.

beats.caption: Kevin Durant became the fifth player in NBA history to reach 33,000 career points.

beats.label: CAREER POINTS
beats.caption: A three-pointer late in the second quarter put Kevin Durant over the mark.

beats.label: POINTS · 10 REBOUNDS
beats.caption: Kevin Durant finished with 20 points and 10 rebounds on 7-of-15 shooting.
He joins LeBron James, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Karl Malone and Kobe Bryant in the 33,000-point club.
Alperen Sengun added a triple-double as the Houston Rockets beat the Phoenix Suns 116-104.
